findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed from a concrete `DetectorHandler` with an `evaluate` stub to a `StatefulDetectorHandler` subclass whose body is just `pass`. `StatefulDetectorHandler` declares several abstract members: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. As a result, `Detector.detector_handler` does `group_type.detector_handler(self)` for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire`, which raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. That exception propagates out of `process_detectors` and stops processing of every other detector in the batch. Keep a concrete stub implementation until the real one exists.

findings.title: Tests never check the value passed to build_occurrence_and_event_data
findings.body: Expected occurrences are always built with `value=6` even when the evaluated value is 10, 100 or 8, e.g. `group_2` here and in `test_results_on_change`/`test_dedupe`. The tests still pass only because the mock builder ignores `value`. Nothing verifies that `evaluate_group_key_value` passes the correct value or status into the new hook, so a regression in the arguments would go undetected. Use the actual values, or assert on the hook call arguments.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The `evaluate` docstring still reads "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`", but the return type is now a dict keyed by group key. Update the docstring to describe the new contract for implementers.
